source: Read-only ARM64 control flow and actual serialized ObservadorResorte prefab. No game native code was executed.

trigger.effect: Set contPiezas[channel]=0. Activation sets conResorte=1 and decrements positionRes if busy. Deactivation sets conResorte=4 and increments positionRes if busy (FuenteTest1.doDesactivarMech0x10A0E10..0x10A0E2C, same for channels2..5). Earlier investigation summaries that called inactive2 were incorrect.
trigger.note: This is not an unconditional increment of the action position. Other trigger classes Resorte/Resorte3/Resorte4 have their own dispatch methods, also listed in the static write evidence.

algorithm: Read contPiezas, numPiezas and positionRes for conResor channel 1..8.
Only when this equals numPiezas, reset contPiezas=0 and advance the shared position.
If proceso==1 and this observer.position < posiMaxTotal, increment positionRes.
If proceso!=1 and positionRes>0, decrement positionRes.
Write the resulting contPiezas and positionRes back to that channel.
completionBarrier.update: ObservadorResorte.Update 0x10C80D0 reads both conResorte and positionRes; doPrevio 0x10C8B30 calls doResorte whenever either differs from its old value.
completionBarrier.busy: doActivaRes 0x10CBE58 sets activadoRes[channel]=true; doInactivaRes 0x10CC334 sets false.

motion.sequence: conResorte st..et first/optional second character select channels. tipoResorte sz..ez is up to three action characters per channel, separated by literal c when there are two channels.
motion.forwardSelection: managerResorte==1, position0/1/2 selects tipoResor1/2/3 and computes the next cached position from the current cached pose.
motion.rotationMethod: ObservadorResorte.doRotation0x10C8F44: Quaternion.RotateTowards semantics. Calculate angle between current and target, SlerpUnclamped with min(rotationSpeed*deltaTime/angle,1). rotationSpeed is degrees per second, not a Slerp factor.
motion.scope: Collision validation, floor blocking, manager states3/4/5, reverse cached poses and second-channel transitions must follow the associated native helper control flow. A direct displacement on every toggle does not implement that state machine.
motion.twoChannelReversal: doCambioResorte0x10C8494 captures current parent position at the selected channel position when its manager changes. doCalPuntoNext(comprueba=2) negates a translation relative to this pose, preserving displacement of the other channel. Rotations return the stored angle.

managerStates.3: Forward failure/blocked cleanup; stops audio, returns to cached pose, releases carried pieces/floor and busy flag
managerStates.5: Reverse failure/blocked cleanup; releases carried pieces/floor and busy flag

carry.query: Physics.OverlapSphere at observer.posx, observer.posy+variay, observer.posz with mascaraBloque2 and sphereRadius.
carry.thirdPiece: Set numPiezas=3, clear sw_obj1 and sw_obj2; doValidarPosActual rejects numPiezas>=3.
topRules: Only valEncima1/2 enters the top-piece validation block.
Actions1,2,3 reject movement if any top piece exists.
valEncima2 rejects movement if any top piece exists.
valEncima1 permits translation carrying up to two eligible top pieces, subject to fixed, destination and bottom collision checks.
carry.fixedComponents: Overlap helper checks ControlFijo.esPiezaFija, ControlPiezaC.esPiezaFija, ControlPieza.esPiezaFija and ControlPiezaPfuente.esPiezaFija before accepting a carrier.
carry.finalHeights: doResorte and doPuntoFinal1 preserve top1/top2 at base+7.6/base+15.2 for the completed pose.

solutionPreview.mode1: MoveBloque.HandleSolution 0x102E700 calls HandleSolutionTotal 0x1033D20: iterate all Save1 entries, capture at each origin and set the parent transform directly to destination, skipping missing captures.
solutionPreview.stepsButton: SaveLoadManager.okSteps 0x1020E98 resets/rebuilds gm, invokes doMoveBloque2 after2 seconds and backbutton2 after6 seconds. Mode2 runs the three-stage animation, not a fixed0.2 second per-move interval.

exceptions.z: Set faseSol9 before capture; skip this entry. so1225 index5 is this exact skip marker and may legitimately have an empty origin.
exceptions.w: Set activadaEspera=true. doProcesoEspera 0x1035210 first observes any activadoRes1..8 true (activadoMech=1), then waits until all eight are false, sets activadoMech=2 and clears activadaEspera.
exceptions.r: HandleSolutionTotal adds float at VA0x5FFD68 to finy; preserve the native branch when decoding the final pose.
exceptions.coordinateTokens: HandleSolutionTotal parses <x...x>, <y...y>, <z...z> and adds parsed integer*7.6 to the associated final coordinate.

solutionPreview.distinction: Literal c inside tipoResorte separates two switch-channel action sequences. Save1.excep=='c' is a movement-height override and does not trigger a mechanism.
